standard.summary: 控制 lulynx 渐进秩 LoRA 随全局训练进度变化的有效 rank；不是 Tensor-Ring，也不是论文 T-LoRA 的 timestep schedule。
standard.effect: tlora_rank_schedule 控制 lulynx 渐进秩 LoRA 随全局训练进度的有效 rank；tlora_orthogonal_init 使用正交初始化。不要理解为论文 T-LoRA 的 timestep schedule。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能。追求比标准 LoRA 更高的参数效率（相同参数量 → 更高隐式秩）时尝试。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。张量环分解的前向计算比标准 LoRA 更复杂，且推理时需要专门支持。

optionDescriptions.cosine: 有效 rank 按余弦变，常是先宽后收。
optionDescriptions.constant: 全程钉在最小秩,不随步数长;当对照用。
optionDescriptions.geometric: 按等比从最小秩乘到最大秩:前期涨得少,收尾涨得快。

standard_en.summary: Controls the effective rank of the lulynx progressive-rank LoRA as global training progresses; it is neither Tensor-Ring nor the paper T-LoRA's timestep schedule.
standard_en.effect: tlora_rank_schedule controls the lulynx progressive-rank LoRA's effective rank against global training progress; tlora_orthogonal_init uses orthogonal initialisation. Do not read it as the paper T-LoRA's timestep schedule.
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature. Try it when you are after higher parameter efficiency than a standard LoRA (the same parameter count -> a higher implicit rank).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. The tensor-ring decomposition's forward pass is more complex than a standard LoRA's, and inference needs dedicated support.

optionDescriptions.cosine: The effective rank follows a cosine, usually wide first and narrowing later.
optionDescriptions.linear: The effective rank changes in a straight line.
optionDescriptions.constant: Pinned at the minimum rank throughout and not growing with the step count; use it as a control.
optionDescriptions.geometric: Multiplies geometrically from the minimum rank up to the maximum: it grows little early and fast towards the end.

advanced.principle: 张量环（Tensor Ring）分解：W ≈ Tr(G_1, G_2, ..., G_k)，通过闭环收缩多个三阶张量核来表示权重矩阵。隐式秩 = 各核维度的乘积，远超标准 LoRA 的显式 rank。
advanced.tradeoffs: 张量环计算比矩阵乘法更复杂（多次收缩），训练速度可能慢 2~3×；但参数效率理论上更高，适合参数量受限的场景。

advanced_en.principle: Tensor Ring decomposition: W ≈ Tr(G_1, G_2, ..., G_k), representing the weight matrix by closed-loop contraction of multiple third-order tensor cores. The implicit rank is the product of the cores' dimensions, far exceeding standard LoRA's explicit rank.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Tensor-ring computation is more complex than matrix multiplication (multiple contractions), so training may be 2~3x slower; but parameter efficiency is theoretically higher, suited to parameter-budget-limited scenarios.
